name: proto-no-streaming
about: 模型能力 supportsStreaming: false 时：循环总是流式请求，基线在发请求前就以 does not support streaming 拒绝（model/request/validateModelRequest.ts:37，unsupported_streaming），一轮以 model_error 结束，provider 收不到主请求。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/nostream
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        nostream:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            supportsStreaming: false
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
